recent.statement: Natural gas prices will drop by -1.5% due to increased supply after EIA weekly natural gas storage report on 2026-07-23
recent.evidence: No archived signal from the 2026-07-21 to 2026-07-28 window documents a -1.5% Henry Hub decline tied to the July 23 EIA storage report; the only gas price signal (S11) is a current snapshot showing -0.94% and references the next storage report on 2026-07-30.

recent.statement: EIA weekly petroleum status report will move CL=F by +1.2% on 2026-07-22
recent.evidence: All signals merely announce upcoming EIA reports scheduled for 2026-07-29/30 and none show any 2026-07-22 report or a +1.2% move in CL=F, so the forecast is unsupported after the window closed.

recent.statement: The Strait of Hormuz will see a significant increase in ship transits within the next week.
recent.evidence: The only Strait of Hormuz signal shows 15 daily transits, 30% below its 30-day average of 21, indicating a decline rather than a significant increase.

recent.statement: Severe thunderstorms will affect the Midwest region within the next week
recent.evidence: No archived signal documents any severe thunderstorm event in the Midwest during the 2026-07-20 to 2026-07-27 window, so the occurrence cannot be established from admissible evidence.

recent.statement: The US will experience a heat wave that leads to widespread power outages within the next week
recent.evidence: No signal was captured showing a US heat wave causing widespread power outages during the window, and an event of that magnitude would almost certainly have been reflected in the signals.

recent.statement: The VIX fear gauge will exceed 20 by the end of the week
recent.evidence: The only VIX reading available shows 18.86, below the stated 20 threshold, and no signal in the window shows VIX exceeding 20.

recent.statement: The Strait of Hormuz will experience a significant increase in ship transits within the next week.
recent.evidence: The only Hormuz signal shows 15 daily transits, 30% below its 30-day average of 21, indicating a decline rather than a significant increase.

recent.statement: The Strait of Hormuz will experience a ship transit count 30% above its 30-day average in the next week
recent.evidence: The only Strait of Hormuz signal shows 15 daily transits, 30% below its 30-day average of 21, contradicting the forecast of 30% above average.

recent.statement: A major shipping disruption will occur within the next week due to a prolonged heatwave affecting the US Gulf Coast region.
recent.evidence: All signals concern Indo-Pacific chokepoint transit volumes and none mention any US Gulf Coast heatwave-related shipping disruption, which an event of that magnitude would have registered.

recent.statement: The NG=F natural gas price will rise by at least 1% on July 23
recent.evidence: No signal reports natural gas (NG=F) prices at all, let alone a ≥1% rise on July 23, so the forecast is unsupported after the window closed.

recent.statement: At least one ship will transit through the Strait of Hormuz at a rate 50% above its 30-day average on July 25
recent.evidence: The only Strait of Hormuz signal shows 15 daily transits, 30% BELOW its 30-day average of 21, with no signal indicating any surge to 50% above average during the window.

recent.statement: The CL=F crude oil price will rise by at least 2% on July 22
recent.evidence: No signal shows a ≥2% rise in CL=F on July 22; the only crude price signal (S9) shows WTI down 2.17% at the window's close, and no archived signal documents the specified single-day gain.
